decision_cadence.frozen: ONE primary decision per certified FUNDING SETTLEMENT INSTANT, per asset (event-driven)
decision_cadence.authority_read: the frozen funding authority rows themselves (funding_time_ms) -- not a synthetic 8h grid
decision_cadence.interpretation: The cadence is derived from the certified settlement instants, so SOL's historical 2h/4h rows are consumed as first-class decisions. No decision is fabricated and none is skipped.

entry_semantics.frozen_anchor: first completed-authority 1h bar OPEN strictly AFTER decision_time
entry_semantics.exact_hour_settlement: T aligned to an hour boundary -> the bar with bar_open_time == T is NOT strictly after T, so entry is at T + 1h bar open
entry_semantics.sub_second_jitter_settlement: provider settlements carry millisecond jitter (e.g. HH:00:00.004); entry is still the next hour bar open, identical to the aligned case

exit_semantics.forward_price_guard: if the exit bar open would exceed the common window end, the signal is NOT emitted (NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA)
exit_semantics.forward_guard_leaks_no_future_price_info: the guard consults only the availability of the exit ANCHOR clock (whether a complete outcome can be evaluated), never any price level

prose_vs_executable.prose_claim: spec prose (exit.holding_period.selection_basis, funding_cashflow_accounting.crosses_settlement, notional_basis_limitation) states '72h spans 9 consecutive 8h settlements' / 'at least 9' / 'applied 9 times'
prose_vs_executable.executable_rule: cashflow iterates every certified settlement in (entry_time, exit_time]; no fixed count is hardcoded
prose_vs_executable.detail: For SOL in the historical 2h regime a 72h hold contains up to ~36 settlements; for 8h assets the boundary-jitter can admit 8 rather than 9. The prose count is therefore factually imprecise, but the executable accounting is correct. Recorded explicitly; not silently reconciled.

common_window.bound_semantics: CLOSED interval on 1h bar-OPEN times (bar_open_time in [start_ms, end_ms])
common_window.source: docs/arc01-prereg-01/ARC01_SPEC_V1.json derived from ARC01_COMMON_CAUSAL_WINDOW.json (funding+OI+price intersection), not dates alone
